item_name: High-Risk Drug Classes: Use and Indication — Hypoglycemic (including insulin)

lookback_source.quote: N0415J1. Hypoglycemic (including insulin): Check if a hypoglycemic medication was taken by the resident at any time during the 7-day observation period (or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days).

lookback_notes: 7-day look-back/observation period, or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days. The N0415 item box states the window as "during the last 7 days or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days" (p. N-4). The manual uses "7-day look-back period" and "7-day observation period" interchangeably across the N0415 subitems; for N0415J both columns are described as the "7-day observation period"/"observation period." The document does not state how the window is counted relative to the ARD on these pages.

conflicts.topic: Window terminology for N0415J1: "7-day observation period" vs. the N0415 item box wording "during the last 7 days"

positions.claim: N0415J1 window is described as the "7-day observation period (or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days)".

source.quote: N0415J1. Hypoglycemic (including insulin): Check if a hypoglycemic medication was taken by the resident at any time during the 7-day observation period (or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days).

positions.claim: The N0415 item box (Column 1) states the window as "during the last 7 days or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days".

source.quote: Check if the resident is taking any medications by pharmacological classification, not how it is used, during the last 7 days or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days

positions.claim: Other N0415 subitems (e.g., N0415A1) use the phrase "7-day look-back period" for the same window.

source.quote: N0415A1. Antipsychotic: Check if an antipsychotic medication was taken by the resident at any time during the 7-day look-back period (or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days).

conflicts.resolution: Terminological only — all passages describe a 7-day window (or since admission/entry or reentry if less than 7 days); the document uses "look-back period" and "observation period" interchangeably. No substantive conflict identified.
